arguments.meaning: class name string (stored at table slot+0)
object size in bytes (stored at table slot+4)
parent class id (low 16 bits stored at table slot+8)

abi.returnValue: uint16 class id (slot index, sequential from 0)
evidence: Function body 0x00401927-0x00401954: ecx=[esp+0xc] (arg1 size), eax=[esp+8] (arg0 name), edi=[esp+0x18] after push esi/push edi = [entry+0xc] (arg2 parent); stores slot+0=eax, slot+4=ecx, slot+8=di (16-bit).
Call site 0x0041554b-0x00415556 (Game): push eax(parent from 0x4018f0); push 0x158; push str.Game; call 0x401900; mov word [0x57b1a2], ax.
Call site 0x00401fc9-0x00401fd1 (Flow): push eax; push 0x54; push str.Flow; call 0x401900.
0x004018f0 is `mov ax, word [0x54f928]; ret` - the last-registered class id used as implicit parent.
Parent value 0x181 (385) appears for root classes (QTask, GFXCapsViewer) and is compared against 0x181 inside 0x00401900 at 0x0040194f.

findings: Retail registers 279 task-type classes during level-1 startup; class ids are strictly sequential 0..278.
Class ids measured live: QTask=0, QObj=1, DynCubeObj=2, RigidDynCubeObj=8, LevelFlow=123, Game=124, Flow=125, EditVariable=126, SubLevel=127, GuardGenerator=128, ConditionalContainer=129.
Object sizes match the earlier measured class slots exactly: LevelFlow 0x128, Game 0x158, Flow 0x54, EditVariable 0xE0, SubLevel 0x120, AIGraph 0xC0.

Some callers pass stale stack as the parent argument (e.g. DynCubeObj parent=0x01D14101, BoneMagicObj parent=0x3F800000); the table stores the low 16 bits of whatever was passed. The port must replay these values, not clean them up.
limits: Attach happens as soon as Frida first lists the process; any registration before that moment is unobserved. settleExpiredWithoutRegistration=false here and the id sequence starts at 0 with no gaps, so no early registration is believed missed.
stackSlot4 is caller stack residue read at [entry+0x10], not a function argument; recorded for completeness only.
One level-1 run; class registration is per-process startup state, so the order is expected stable across levels, but only level 1 was captured.
